description: Ensure skill does not contain bash-specific constructs incompatible with Windows PowerShell
explanation: Bash-specific redirections and multi-line backslash continuations fail in PowerShell on Windows.

description: Ensure PR review mode avoids destructive branch checkout in active workspace
explanation: Direct checkout overwrites uncommitted user files and alters working tree state.

description: Ensure automated APPROVE or REQUEST_CHANGES reviews require explicit human confirmation
explanation: AI reviews must not auto-submit binding approvals or change requests without user sign-off.

description: Ensure skill advises against reading all changed files in full for large diffs
prohibited_patterns: Read each changed file in full
explanation: Reading all changed files in full causes context exhaustion and token throttling.

description: Ensure validation phase promotes targeted testing rather than blind full-suite runs
explanation: Targeted testing accelerates feedback and prevents long-running suite timeouts.
